title: Isles of the Pacific II: Wind, Wave, Star, Bird
version: National Geographic, December 1974, pp.746–753 (archival scan mirror)
lineage: First-person participant/observer article published before Hōkūleʻa; the PDF was downloaded from an archive mirror and retained. Supports prior Micronesian navigation, not Polynesian double-hull construction.

passages.locator: Printed pp.747–748; PDF page 2, Caroline Islands/Saipan passage
passages.note: Lewis writes that Caroline navigators used small sailing canoes to Saipan, 550 miles across open sea.
